Assets and Licenses
===================

This section documents the various assets and their licensing information used in the pregnancy application.

Icons
-----

The application uses the following icon sets:

* **Pregnancy Icons**: `Pregnancy Icon Set <https://www.freevector.com/pregnancy-icon-set-21124>`_
* **Ultrasound Icons**: `Ultrasound Icon <https://uxwing.com/ultrasound-machine-icon/>`_
* **Other Icons**: `Material Design Icons <https://pictogrammers.com/library/mdi/>`_

Images
--------------
* **About Us Images**: Fetched from the group members.
* **Content Images**: Generated by Gemini Banana model.

License Compliance
------------------

All assets used in this application are properly licensed and attributed according to their respective terms of use. Users should ensure compliance with these licenses when using or redistributing the application.
